name: Triage
description: Bugs, alerts and security warnings sorted by how far they reach, each with an owner: reports from the app, the Lemma, Slack, GitHub, a report form, Sentry, PostHog and GitHub's security alerts become one item each, counted in people where a source can count them, with a suggested owner and the reason, and one key per decision. Accepting makes a team task; everyone who asked is told when it is done.
